title: SFXManager.cs
summary: Mirrors MusicManager for one-shot sound effects, and additionally synthesizes its own UI click sound in code — no imported audio asset needed for that one.

notes.text: Builds the synthesized click sound once at startup rather than every time it's played.
The envelope ramps linearly from 1 down to 0 across the clip's length, so the tone fades out smoothly instead of clipping abruptly.

notes.match: public static SFXManager Instance { get; private set; }
notes.text: Same self-bootstrapping singleton pattern as MusicManager, down to the exact polling approach for volume — the two classes are deliberately parallel.
Same volume-polling Update as MusicManager, just against the separate 'Mindscape.SFX' key.
Public API for playing any arbitrary clip through the shared, volume-synced AudioSource — e.g. a footstep or pickup sound.
Convenience wrapper specifically for the built-in UI click sound, used throughout MainMenuController.

Generates a 60ms, 880Hz sine wave with a linear fade-out envelope, sample by sample, and hands it to Unity as a real AudioClip — a deliberate choice to avoid shipping (or needing someone to create) an audio asset just for button clicks.
AudioClip.Create allocates an empty clip with the given format, then SetData fills it with the samples computed above.
